svg.title: Why a timed plan needs an ADG
svg.desc: Three Gantt panels for two AGVs crossing cell b: the plan, execution by the clock after a delay (both AGVs in b), and execution by dependencies (AGV 2 waits).

g.text: A planner hands out times. Real AGVs are late or early. Executing by the clock lets a late robot collide with one that is on time; executing by dependencies keeps the planned order and
